description: Shrub with pinnately compound leaves of 5-11 serrate leaflets. Flat-topped compound cymes bearing many small DARK PURPLE-BLACK DRUPES when fruiting, carried on conspicuously RED-PURPLE PEDICELS.
source: Flora of North America vol. 18 (Sambucus); card #31, which shows fruit
notes: The card shows FRUIT, so a flowering umbel is the wrong phenological stage and must not be substituted. CRITICAL: the red-purple PEDICELS are not fruit. The drupes are round, dark and clustered; the pedicels are thin and radiating. A photograph showing only red stalks with no dark drupes does not meet this brief.
derived_from: botanical description and the printed card, NOT a colour signature
